observedFailures: Can you find the user manual? repeatedly triggered photo analysis and timeout messages.
#3292 removed the MiniMax timeout, allowing the nameplate to be recognized.
The bot recognized the FC-202 but still said it had no documentation and asked for a model number already visible on the plate.
A later photo containing the model information was routed to the electrical-print interpreter.
The interpreter correctly described it as a nameplate but stated that it could not retrieve external files.
Mike uploaded a PDF named or captioned VLT User Manual.
Telegram replied: Hub intake is not configured.
Mike then said: i gave you the user manual can you help me
The bot denied access to the PDF and told him to type the model number and consult a vendor manual.
Repeated attempts produced duplicate progress and timeout responses.
